headline: Sensex surges over 1,200 points as Reliance rally and lower crude oil prices boost Indian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong Q2 earnings results and massive rally in Reliance Industries shares.
Decline in global crude oil prices easing cost pressures.
Continued government capex push and strong domestic economic growth outlook.
Positive corporate earnings results, including robust quarterly performance from Marico.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,200 points and Nifty rose towards 23,450 as bulls returned to Indian equities.
Reliance Industries posted its best single-day gains since 2020 following strong Q2 earnings.
Marico reported a 29-31% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to around ₹550-558 crore.
TRAI tightened telecom complaint redressal rules, capping fines at ₹20 lakh.
summary:
Indian stock market indices jumped nearly 2% on Monday, with Sensex rallying over 1,200 points and Nifty nearing 23,450.
The market surge was primarily driven by a historic single-day gain in Reliance Industries shares and lower crude oil prices.
Marico also logged strong gains after reporting a ~30% jump in Q2 net profit driven by robust volume growth.
